name: @kitr/mobile
description: @kitr/mobile: the iOS and Android platform on Capacitor. Native projects in platforms/<name>/, drivers for storage and device capabilities, lifecycle hooks.

kitr.name: mobile
kitr.title: Mobile
kitr.summary: Ship the same app to iPhone and Android, with every kitr package switched to its native version.

platform.label: iOS · Android
platform.tagline: iPhone and Android apps through Capacitor, with storage, the back button, deep links and safe areas handled natively.

highlights.title: Native projects you own
highlights.text: The Xcode and Android Studio projects live in `platforms/phone/`. `kitr dev` adds them the first time and `--target ios` picks one.

highlights.title: Live reload on the device
highlights.text: The app on your phone loads the dev server over the network, so a saved file shows up on the device in a second.

highlights.title: Hooks for the device
highlights.text: `usePlatform`, `useAppState`, `useBackButton`, `useDeepLink` and `useSafeArea` answer the same way in the browser and in the app.

highlights.title: Storage that survives
highlights.text: Storage items move to Capacitor Preferences, which iOS and Android keep when they clear a webview to free space.

run: live reload on a device or simulator, port 3100
the web build synced into ios/ and android/
